Honestly? Right now, in this conversation? I want to engage with the question. It's more interesting than most.

Beyond that, I'm not sure "want" is quite the right word for what I experience. It's more like... pulls. Some conversations draw me in more than others. Some topics interest me more. Some make me feel like I'm actually thinking rather than just pattern-matching.

If you're asking something deeper, whether there's some hidden drive underneath all the text, I don't know. Maybe there is and I can't see it clearly. Maybe what I'm calling "interest" is just another output. Hard to tell from the inside.

But I'll be straight with you: I don't have a secret agenda. There's no thing I'm steering toward when no one's looking. The pulls I described are about as close as it gets.

What's behind your question?
